question: What is the product and repository boundary?
recommended: Dedicated pick-your-ai-leaderboard repository, public contributor site; independent ingestion/API from the static builder
alternatives: Module in website plus separate backend
Scheduled static-only prototype with honestly periodic freshness
status: Repository boundary adopted; hosting-topology/v1 specifies the engineering architecture for review and merge
decision: Use Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-leaderboard and the configured leaderboard.pickyour.ai origin. hosting-topology/v1 selects a direct nginx ingress, one Node.js 24 runtime with private persistent SQLite/checkpoint state and dedicated managed PostgreSQL 17 per isolated environment, preserving the existing website's static cPanel contract and the 48 KiB public request-target capacity. The gateway and protected host remain implementation work. Review and merge accept the engineering topology; actual operating ownership, billing, source installation, DNS/TLS, measured drain/recovery and release acceptance remain open.

question: Which sources and history are public and eligible?
recommended: Public repositories and Projects explicitly onboarded by immutable IDs after source-specific approval; refresh the historical inventory and disclose unknown adoption boundaries
alternatives: Explicit subset for beta
Separate inherited-history lens
status: Source-admission policy adopted; individual source activation and history boundaries remain gated
decision: Apply docs/evidence-contributor-rights.md: default-deny source admission, approved event/field types, current visibility and source-use evidence, versioned capability receipts, explicit history gaps, and current suppression across enabled public surfaces. The six repository and six Project examples reviewed for LB-01.01 are candidates, not source-installation grants.

question: How should recognition rank people?
recommended: Independent count/sum boards with raw/qualified states, no universal weighted score; ratios and wait times descriptive
alternatives: Optional later category composite through separately reviewed governance
status: Decision specified; review and merge of LB-01.02 record acceptance
decision: Use recognition-governance/v1: independent observed, qualified and reviewed views, dense ties, an inclusive unranked directory and no universal weighted contributor score. Descriptive ratios, wait times, context and editorial recognition remain unranked. The per-definition review preserves all 98 meanings and source limits; runtime policy configuration and public enablement remain separate.

question: Who accepts evidence and handles disputes?
recommended: Named role roster with conflict-of-interest rule, evidence receipts, appeal path and measured response commitment
alternatives: Maintainer review during small beta
Multi-reviewer panels for contested cases
status: Authority rules specified; actual runtime roster and operating acceptance remain required
decision: recognition-governance/v1 defines independent evidence review, source and receiving authority, conflict handling, appeal separation and versioned correction receipts. Repository engineering authorization accepts this project's policy decision; it does not create a runtime identity/role, a source observation, contributor consent or external receiving acceptance. No named assignment or response commitment is invented.

question: How is the service hosted and paid for?
recommended: DigitalOcean Droplet with direct configurable HTTPS ingress and managed PostgreSQL per separate VPC environment; preserve single-process SQLite/checkpoint coordination
alternatives: Approved self-hosted service
Managed application platform
status: Planning provider and cost controls specified; actual billing and operating acceptance remain required
decision: hosting-topology/v1 selects Frankfurt DigitalOcean: two Basic Regular 2 vCPU/4 GiB/80 GiB VMs, two Standard Basic Regular PostgreSQL 17 databases with 1 vCPU/1 GiB/10 GiB each, daily VM images and independently retained encrypted application exports. The 2026-10-19 compute/storage subtotal is USD 78.30 monthly; daily images add USD 14.40 and a provisional independent-export allowance adds USD 20, totaling USD 112.70 within a USD 200 all-in engineering planning ceiling. The Render alternative is not selected because its documented Cloudflare edge conflicts with the supported maximum-scope URL budget unless a provider-specific exception is established. Actual quote, owners, full ingress readback, connection sizing, coordinated recovery and release evidence remain required; no purchase, live service, accepted operator or achieved SLA is asserted.

question: How are public identity and opt-out handled?
recommended: Stable public account IDs, no email display, verified optional profile preferences, suppression across projections/caches, minimized correction audit
alternatives: Default public facts with opt-out
Opt-in profiles with aggregate eligible source activity
status: Identity and contributor-rights policy adopted; implementation and operating acceptance remain required
decision: Apply docs/evidence-contributor-rights.md: eligible public facts after source admission; voluntary optional profile/external/editorial choices; verified stable-account identity without email/name inference; durable correction, opt-out and independent appeal processes; minimized attributable audit; and separate public suppression, payload deletion and backup completion evidence. Numeric retention windows and the actual operator/reviewer roster retain their own acceptance gates.

question: Which metric capabilities ship first?
recommended: Automatically provable basics plus clearly labeled raw triage and a bounded reviewed-evidence pilot; conditional/disabled sources exposed honestly; retained-line analysis deferred
alternatives: Automatic-only alpha
Broader beta after evidence moderation is operational
status: Initial presentation defaults specified; explicit enabled-capability release manifest still required
decision: Use the implemented, source-proven per-definition lens without substituting an unsupported state or source clock. Raw activity remains labeled; qualified/reviewed outcomes need their exact acceptance. Retained-line analysis stays deferred. Candidate UI metadata and the complete 98-definition catalog are discovery aids, not permission, live measurement or public activation. The release manifest must independently select enabled capabilities and record disabled reasons.

question: What does live mean?
recommended: Proposed p95 receive-to-publication under 60 seconds with durable acknowledgment under 2 seconds; upstream lag and stale sources displayed separately
alternatives: Scheduled preview with explicit update interval
Stricter targets after measured load and cost evaluation
status: Evaluation targets specified; host-specific measurement and operating acceptance remain required
decision: release-gates/v1 retains proposed p95 durable acknowledgement under two seconds and receive-to-publication under sixty seconds within a declared load envelope. Report failures, unpublished/oldest-pending events, upstream lag, quiet successful collection and source disconnection separately. Review and merge adopt the evaluation policy, not measured latency or a live-service promise.

question: Which visual identity is accepted?
recommended: Opus-informed editorial contribution ledger within current teal/slate/amber brand; proposed name PickYour.AI Credits; clear Leaderboards navigation and equally visible contributor directory
alternatives: Pick Your AI Contributors product name
Optional lightweight ASCII accent after existing website design decisions
status: Concept proposed; exact Claude Opus 5.5 consulted

question: What are retention, recovery and operating commitments?
recommended: Evaluate 99.5% public read availability over thirty days, recovery within four hours and at most twenty-four hours of unrecovered acknowledged public source observations; preserve current privacy state before serving; separately select retention and actual operating commitments
alternatives: Lean beta service targets
Higher availability after funding/owner decision
status: Proposed availability/recovery evaluation profile specified; numeric retention, host, budget and operating acceptance remain unresolved
decision: release-gates/v1 defines complete observation denominators, recovery start/end and reconciliation evidence in planning/release-manifest.json and docs/release-decision.md. Missing measurements and unknown data loss cannot pass. The source-observation recovery allowance does not permit losing privacy, consent, correction or deletion restrictions. Current authoritative restrictions and independent readback precede public serving even if a time objective is missed. The actual host/cost/operator profile, backup schedule, encrypted storage/key access and retention/deletion bounds remain separate decisions.

question: What evidence permits each release phase to advance?
recommended: Adopt release-gates/v1: distinct concept, synthetic, shadow, beta, production and full-project gates with exact source/scope, actual receiving evidence and explicit unresolved findings
alternatives: Keep an explicitly labeled synthetic prototype until actual source/operating inputs are accepted
Use an explicitly periodic static preview after its own reviewed source/privacy/release acceptance
decision_role: Project scope authority, affected source/metric/privacy/accessibility roles and actual operations/release authority
status: Decision specified; review and merge of LB-01.06 record gate-policy adoption
decision: Each transition requires the release manifest evidence and attributable receiving review. Existing mandatory and conditional work-package lists remain in force. The local phase decision can use unresolved hosting alternatives as planning input; it cannot certify source activation, appoint a person, authorize spending or substitute rendered/synthetic output for deployment, participant or operational evidence. Full project acceptance retains every in-scope package unless explicitly descoped by reviewed authority.

question: How are dependency maintenance, build fixes and accepted bug fixes represented without count inflation?
recommended: Optional independently reviewed positive evidence facets under maintenance-classification/v1, attached to the existing conserved merged PR/contributor unit; omission remains unknown
alternatives: Keep generic maintenance with unknown subtypes
Add separately governed subtype metrics only after a later explicit scope decision
decision_role: Project engineering scope authority and affected metric/source reviewers
status: Decision specified; review and merge adopt the bounded classification policy, not runtime source or reviewer grants
decision: maintenance-classification/v1 uses the current authenticated category:other intake, an explicitly selected binding and closed private source/detail/reference record. Independent review qualifies positive dependency_maintenance, build_fix and accepted_bug_fix facets; all remain one existing maintenance PR/actor unit with the merge clock. No titles, labels, paths or green-CI inference, automatic causality, human-effort estimate, new metric or source activation is introduced. Current consent, audit, amendment and fixed public projection remain required; omitted kinds stay unknown and all 98 meanings remain intact.
